CHELE RESULTS: November 2026 Chemical Engineers Licensure Exam, List of Passers
 Admin 
 Published Thursday, November 19, 2026 
 MANILA, Philippines – The November 2026 Chemical Engineers Licensure Examination (ChELE) results, including the complete list of passers, topnotchers (top 10), top performing schools, and performance of schools, are released by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) on Thursday, November 19, 2026, one (1) working day after the exam.
 As announced, 814 out of 955 (85.24%) passed the November 2026 ChELE.
 PRC conducted the ChemEng computer-based exam on November 14, 15, and 16, 2026 in the cities of Manila, Baguio, Butuan, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Koronadal, Legazpi, Lucena, Palawan, Pampanga, Rosales, and Tuguegarao. 
 Related ChELE Results
 Top 10: November 2026 Chemical Engineering board exam results 
 Top Schools: November 2026 Chemical Engineering board exam results 
 The members of the Board of Chemical Engineering who gave the licensure examination are Engr. Maricris C. Vines, Chairperson; Engr. Cezar S. de la Cruz and Engr. Shirlyn B. Chua-Reyes, Members.

 Release of Results
 Update of 10:17AM, November 19, 2026: PRC confirmed that CheLE results will be released today.
 To quote, PRC said: "To the nation's future Licensed Nutritionists-Dietitians and Chemical Engineers, may your hard work lead to success and your prayers turn into answered blessings. Your time to shine is now! The results of the November 2026 Nutritionists-Dietitians and Chemical Engineers Computer-Based Licensure Examinations will be released soon!"
 Previous Update
 Originally, the results of the November 2026 Chemical Engineers Computer-Based Licensure Examination (ChELE) were expected to be released on November 18, 2026, in accordance with PRC Resolution No. 2113, series of 2025.
 However, November 16 to 18, 2026, were declared special non-working days in the National Capital Region (NCR) in connection with the 49th ASEAN Summit, under Proclamation No. 1447.
 In view of the holiday declaration, the release of the ChELE results is now expected on November 19, 2026. 
 Registration and Oathtaking
 Registration for the issuance of Professional Identification Card (ID) and Certificate of Registration will be done on-line. Please go to https://online.prc.gov.ph/ and follow instructions for initial registration.
 Date of Registration: TBA
 Those who will register are required to bring the following: 
 screenshot of system-generated Registration Form
 valid government-issued ID
 Successful examinees should personally register and sign in the Roster of Registered Professionals.
 The date and venue for the oathtaking ceremony of the new successful examinees in the said examination WILL BE ANNOUNCED LATER, PRC said.
 Coverage of Examinations
 The three-day examination covered the following subjects: physical and chemical principles, chemical engineering principles and general engineering, ethics and contracts.
 Previous Examinations
 The May 2026 Chemical Engineers Computer-Based Licensure Examination (ChELE) results were released one (1) working day after the last day of examinations. Of the 728 examinees, 565 passed. Bren Daniel Josue Ebriega of the University of the Philippines (UP) Diliman led the batch with a rating of 90.80%.
 The November 2025 Chemical Engineers Licensure Examination (CheLE) results, meanwhile, were released immediately after the examination. A total of 719 out of 910 examinees passed, with Abell Armamento Alcantara of Batangas State University–Alangilan securing the top spot with a rating of 90.30%.
 Results of the May 2025 ChemEng board exam were also released immediately after the examination. Of the 799 examinees, 602 passed. Patricia Isabel Rebancos Soriano of De La Salle University–Manila ranked first with a rating of 88.60%.
 Earlier, the November 2024 Chemical Engineers Licensure Examination results were announced within two (2) working days after the last day of examinations. A total of 688 out of 951 examinees passed, led by Kenn Rovikk Estacio Logdat of UP Diliman, who earned the top rating of 90.90%.
